text: Community Run August 15 Henrietta Township (Pleasant Lake) 4.77 miles • Taxes & Local Control A loop around Pleasant Lake starting and ending at Pleasant Lake County Park. Lower taxes, protect homeowners, and keep decisions local.
Community Run August 25 Tompkins Township 3.9 miles • Election Integrity A 3.9-mile loop starting and ending at Tompkins Town Hall. Proof of citizenship, photo ID, and clean voter rolls.

Community Run August 29 Hanover Village & Township 6 miles • Cost of Living Door to door through the village and township. Cut taxes, no tax on tips, overtime, or Social Security, and lower energy costs.

Community Run October 1 Webster Township (Parks Lake) 4.6 miles • Protecting the Unborn From Marquis Drive near Parks Lake to 9122 Huron River Drive. Neighbors were concerned about pro-life — and glad to hear Tawn will protect the unborn.

Community Run October 3 Sandstone Township (Parma) 5.4 miles • Property taxes and the schools A loop through Parma village. Neighbors kept coming back to the tax bill, a break for seniors, and what the schools are teaching.

Community Run September 12 Lyndon Township (Run Woodstock) 5 miles • First Responders & 9/11 Flower Power 5 Mile at Run Woodstock. Tawn finished in 43:54 — 4th overall among the women — dedicated to police, firefighters, and the memory of September 11, 2001.
Community Run September 25 Brooklyn Village 4.6 miles • Every Village on the Map Met at Swain Memorial Park, canvassed the village, and finished at Village Creamery on Main Street.

Community Run September 29 Freedom Township (Pleasant Lake) 5 miles • Freedom — Speech, Faith, and Property A sunset loop from Freedom Township Hall around Pleasant Lake. Neighbors, yard signs, and a township whose name should still mean something.

Community Run September 5 Liberty Township (Round Lake) 5.4 miles • Liberty & Ending Political Lawfare A rainy loop around Round Lake from 130 Steves Scenic Dr. Equal justice, no two-tier legal system, and an end to using courts as a political weapon.
Leg 1 June 13 Salem Twp → Northfield Twp 5.75 miles • Energy Policies Starting the journey with a focus on Michigan's energy future and lowering costs for families.
Leg 10 July 11 Veterans Park → Faith Baptist Church, Chelsea 5.44 miles • Faith, Family, and Freedom Putting faith and family at the center of our communities.
Leg 11 July 14 Faith Baptist Church → Grass Lake 6.59 miles • Rural Strength & Local Control Empowering rural communities and defending local decision-making.
Leg 12 July 18 Grass Lake → Center Lake (Michigan Center) 8.14 miles • Lakeside Values & Communities Our longest leg yet — celebrating beautiful lakes, family, and local control.

Leg 13 July 22 Michigan Center → Jackson County GOP HQ 5.08+1 miles • Supporting Republican Women & Conservative Leadership Finish at Jackson GOP Headquarters and join the Jackson Republican Women’s Coalition First Event at 6:00 PM!
Leg 14 July 25 Jackson → Cascades Park 3 miles • Make Michigan Healthy Again Family-friendly leg promoting movement, outdoor activity, and fighting chronic disease through parks and recreation.

Leg 15 — GRAND FINALE! August 1 Cascades Park → Spring Arbor (Red Egg Creamery) 7.63 miles • Tawn’s Platform for Michigan Families The final leg completing the full Run for Tawn! A clear summary of the common-sense conservative platform she will take to Lansing. Celebrate with us at the finish line.
Leg 2 June 15 Northfield Twp → Whitmore Lake 5.97 miles • Taxes & Cost of Living Fighting for lower taxes and relief from the rising cost of living.
Leg 3 June 24 Whitmore Lake → Whitmore Lake Rd 3.04 miles • Parental Rights in Education Standing up for parents and quality education for every child.
Leg 4 June 20 Whitmore Lake Rd → Olson Park, Ann Arbor 6.8 miles • Public Safety & Crime Supporting law enforcement and keeping our communities safe.
Leg 5 June 22 Olson Park → West Park, Ann Arbor 4.23 miles • Jobs & Economic Freedom Cutting regulations and creating opportunity for Michigan workers and businesses.
Leg 6 June 29 West Park → Marshall Park, Scio Twp 5.18 miles • Election Integrity & Transparency Securing our elections and restoring trust in the process.
Leg 7 July 2 Marshall Park → Dexter's Pub 4.55 miles • Second Amendment Rights Defending our God-given right to keep and bear arms.
Leg 8 July 7 Dexter's Pub → Fourmile Lake 4.6 miles • Pro-Life Values Standing for life and protecting the most vulnerable among us.
Leg 9 July 10 Fourmile Lake → Veterans Park, Chelsea 3.09 miles • Support Veterans Honoring those who served and fighting for our veterans.
